verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents its RESTful API as the same interface its official SDKs use to report errors and deploys. It explicitly says the API 'can be used to create notifiers for additional languages', and notes that its community has built many more platform clients. Dedicated post_client_item tokens for sending events and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering Item and Occurrence resources further support custom ingestion clients. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of the item payload schema in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration of a third-party client sending events.
